title: Stage 14 — Dans1 build b1117e054a71: the assistant's wireframe and workbench tools verified in production and Windows-native, all gates including graceful shutdown pass
platform: Frozen Dans1 build (High/16, seven sequential gates, 299 focused tests) · production preview 127.0.0.1:8096 at desktop 1280x800 and tablet 1024x768 · isolated Windows-native executable (WebView2, CDP 9281, not installed) at 2560x1370 · isolated agent-browser profiles · real provider gemini-3.8-flash with the user-authorized key (6 messages in total)
summary: The tree carrying the assistant's multi-storey wireframe operations (SC-08), the sheet/takeoff/price-book/backup tools (SC-10) and the harness guardrails (SC-09) was frozen, built on Dans1 and exercised on the production bundle and on the Windows-native executable. All seven build gates passed; the executable, installer and 228 web artifacts are hash-verified and the served bundle carries the build id. Regression journeys for saves, sheets, pricing and the hardened assistant passed on both platforms. Asked in plain words, the assistant drew a three-storey 20 m by 12 m wireframe on both platforms, added and undid a storey, and organised the Redburn sheet register, reported takeoff blockers and price books and stored a verified backup. The native app then closed gracefully on request, so the verified-build pointer moves to b1117e054a71.
